coverage_explanation: Exercises all five supplied target inputs, all three comparison results, integer-centimeter boundaries immediately below and above a target, changing sensor measurements, and return to equality. Checks the prompt, serial baud, setup deadline, and timely correct responses while rejecting contradictory comparison reports. This is finite-suite coverage, not exhaustive equivalence.
assumptions: Preserve the supplied wiring: TRIG pin 3 and ECHO pin 2.
Serial communication uses the explicitly supplied 9600 baud and line-or-idle framing. Decimal integer targets followed by newline represent the supplied numeric test inputs.
The public acceptance profile supplies the 500ms setup deadline and 250ms serial-command response deadline.
Sensor changes precede subsequent commands by 400ms so the comparison does not depend on an unspecified sampling phase.
Only integer-centimeter stimuli are used because the requirement does not explicitly distinguish rounding from truncation for fractional centimeters.
No LED, button, or analog bench defaults are needed.
